Waste management for breweries

We take over all the waste your plant generates, with one operation, one contract and indicators ready for your ESG report.

One partner for every waste stream

Spent grain, surplus yeast, trub, wastewater treatment sludge, diatomaceous earth, packaging and recyclables. Each fraction goes to its highest value destination, with reuse as the priority.

An operation that fits your routine

Crews and equipment sized to the brewery's production pace, with scheduled collection, contingency for demand peaks and a direct line to the plant team.

End to end traceability

Every load is documented from the plant gate to its final destination. You receive regular reports with volumes, destinations and auditable environmental indicators.

What is included

  • Waste assessment by line and process
  • Destination plan that prioritises reuse
  • Proper collection, transport and storage
  • Environmental documentation and manifest control
  • Indicator reports for ESG and audits
  • Service in Brazil and Paraguay

Composting
